images_size_positive.name: images_size_positive
images_size_positive.value: ("images"."width" is null or "images"."width" > 0) and ("images"."height" is null or "images"."height" > 0)

cases_pii_due_idx.name: cases_pii_due_idx
cases_pii_due_idx.where: "cases"."pii_deleted_at" is null and "cases"."pii_delete_after" is not null

cases_reference_matches_service.name: cases_reference_matches_service
cases_reference_matches_service.value: ("cases"."service"::text = 'lost_found' and "cases"."reference" like 'LF-%') or ("cases"."service"::text = 'complaint' and "cases"."reference" like 'CP-%') or ("cases"."service"::text = 'borrowing' and "cases"."reference" like 'BR-%')

borrowing_lines_return.name: borrowing_lines_return
borrowing_lines_return.value: ("borrowing_lines"."returned_good" is null and "borrowing_lines"."damaged" is null and "borrowing_lines"."lost" is null) or ("borrowing_lines"."returned_good" >= 0 and "borrowing_lines"."damaged" >= 0 and "borrowing_lines"."lost" >= 0 and "borrowing_lines"."returned_good" + "borrowing_lines"."damaged" + "borrowing_lines"."lost" = "borrowing_lines"."quantity")
